ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROTTING_SKULL.title: Rotting Skull
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROTTING_SKULL.descriptio: If your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional card at the start of your turn.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROTTING_SKULL.flavor: Find the other one too! Is this the beginning of a new collection?
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-TABASCO_SAUCE.title: Tabasco Sauce
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-TABASCO_SAUCE.descriptio: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Healing effects are reduced by [blue]{HpReductionPercent}%[/blue].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-TABASCO_SAUCE.flavor: Ah, that's hot! That is hot!
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HIGH_HEELS.title: High Heels
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HIGH_HEELS.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]Clumsy[/red] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HIGH_HEELS.flavor: Elegant, but not very comfortable for combat.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-POGO_STICK.title: Pogo Stick
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-POGO_STICK.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Whenever you trigger [gold]Sly[/gold], shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]Dazed[/red] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OLD_T_V.title: Old TV
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OLD_T_V.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]Reception Problems[/red] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OLD_T_V.flavor: Too old to use, too good to throw away.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-AGGRESSION_PROTOCOL.desc: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. While you have an Attack in hand, the first Skill or Power card you play each turn costs {EnergyCostIncrease:energyIcons()} more.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-AGGRESSION_PROTOCOL.flav: Prioritization updated: Violence first, questions later.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-FADING_STAR.title: Fading Star
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-FADING_STAR.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and lose {Stars:starIcons()}.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-FADING_STAR.flavor: The stars fade, but you press on.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROYAL_COFFERS.title: Royal Coffers
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROYAL_COFFERS.descriptio: If you have at least [blue]{Gold}[/blue] unspent [gold]Gold[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROYAL_COFFERS.flavor: Money doesn't buy happiness. Just energy.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-BRASS_COIL.title: Brass Coil
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-BRASS_COIL.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Enemies start combat with [blue]{ArtifactPower}[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. In single-enemy combats, the enemy gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold] instead.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-NECROTIC_SCYTHE.title: Necrotic Scythe
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-NECROTIC_SCYTHE.descript: The first time each turn you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-CURSED_PENTAGRAM.title: Cursed Pentagram
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-CURSED_PENTAGRAM.descrip: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Obtain a [red]Curse[/red] for every [blue]{Cards}[/blue] future non-[red]Curse[/red] cards added to your deck.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-CURSED_PENTAGRAM.flavor: Don't mess with the force you don't understand...
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-DEAD_BATTERY.title: Dead Battery
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-DEAD_BATTERY.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. You cannot play more than [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Power card per turn.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ENERGIZED_COIN.title: Energized Coin
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ENERGIZED_COIN.descripti: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Whenever you climb a floor, [gold]Energized Coin[/gold] is rerolled to have the negative effect of either [gold]Sozu[/gold] or [gold]Ectoplasm[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HUGE_HOUSE.title: Huge House
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HUGE_HOUSE.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Upon pickup, lose [blue]{PotionsToLose}[/blue] random potion. Lose [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Lower your Max HP by [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue]. Obtain [blue]{StrikesToAdd}[/blue] [red]Strike[/red]. Downgrade [blue]{CardsToDowngrade}[/blue] random card.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-MAGNIFYING_GLASS.title: Magnifying Glass
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-MAGNIFYING_GLASS.descrip: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Enemies have [blue]{MoreHpPercent}%[/blue] more HP.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-MAGNIFYING_GLASS.flavor: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-NEVER_ENDING_SPARKLER.de: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. [blue]{ChancePercent}%[/blue] of Question Mark rooms are changed into Elite rooms.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OGRE_HEAD.title: Ogre Head
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OGRE_HEAD.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Whenever you play a card that targets an enemy, you have [blue]{MisdirectionPercent}%[/blue] chance to target another enemy.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-RED_ROSE.title: Red Rose
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-RED_ROSE.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. ALL enemies start combat with [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-RED_ROSE.flavor: There is no rose without a thorn.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-SPIDER_WEB.title: Spider Web
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-SPIDER_WEB.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Each turn, one random Attack in [gold]Hand[/gold] costs {EnergyCostIncrease:energyIcons()} more.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-SPIDER_WEB.flavor: Use it to catch your enemies, not to catch yourself...
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-STICKY_HAND.title: Sticky Hand
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-STICKY_HAND.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Whenever you would take a card in a card reward, you take ALL the offered cards instead.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-STICKY_HAND.flavor: Definitely going to come in handy.
